metaDescription: Order custom wool embroidered patches for a classic, textured look. Perfect for uniforms and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Wool embroidered patches offer a classic, textured look that stands out from standard polyester or twill patches. The natural wool fibers provide a soft, durable finish ideal for uniforms, blazers, and commemorative events. Whether you need custom patches for a corporate team or a safety award program, wool adds a premium feel that holds up to frequent wear and washing. Choose from various edge options like merrowed or heat-cut to match your design.
heroAltText: Custom wool embroidered patches with colorful stitching and merrowed edge on a dark fabric background
